motion.title: Light that gently settles
motion.overview: Let the peach and amber bloom breathe softly behind the crescent, while the milk-cream reading areas and burgundy type stay stable. A small amount of movement gives the evening a sense of warmth without turning the timer into a visualizer.

alternatives.title: Sample garden first
alternatives.detail: Let visitors explore an explicitly labeled demo before adding a plant. Demo care and notes remain in a separate namespace; Create my garden opens an empty plant form. Compare setup completion and accidental demo-record saves.

checks: Create Pip once; duplicate taps/retry keep one record.
Still damp saves an observation, never a watering event.
After Save soil check the due count becomes zero; Undo restores the task.
Save note replaces the editor with one dated note; Cancel never deletes earlier notes.

auxiliary_routes.discard-note: Keep editing returns focus to the draft. Discard clears only the unsaved note and returns to the Notes list; it never deletes a saved observation.
auxiliary_routes.photo-picker: Open the platform’s limited photo picker only on Add a photo. Selection shows a removable thumbnail and upload progress. Cancel changes nothing; failed upload retains the note and allows retry/removal before saving.
auxiliary_routes.plant-detail: Show Pip’s name, species, location, observation history and Edit. Edit uses the plant form with the same record ID; saving updates rather than creates. Back restores the source screen.
auxiliary_routes.plant-picker: List known plants with the current selection. Selecting a different plant confirms reassigning a dirty note, then returns to the same draft. Cancel keeps Pip and all entered text.
auxiliary_routes.plant-search: Search species with a labeled input, loading, no-results and retry states. Choose a result or Unknown; apply the species ID to the plant draft. Cancel preserves the previous value.
auxiliary_routes.settings: Show preference rows and account/help links in a sheet. Each switch exposes its actual saved value. Close returns to the invoking tab, scroll and focus; notification permission remains a separate explicit action.
auxiliary_routes.snooze: Choose later today, tomorrow or a date/time; Apply changes the task due time, not its completion status. Cancel preserves the old date. Reminder permission refusal does not prevent saving a new due time.

motion.title: A small garden, quietly alive
motion.method: Veo illustration study; layered motion fallback
motion.overview: Keep the painterly gardener, warm window and Pip recognizable. Let a few leaves and filtered light move within the picture; the care decisions and notes stay calm and easy to read.

references.title: Google · Video generation
references.finding: Image-directed video is a motion-study option. Use a currently supported Veo endpoint at production time; these briefs intentionally do not pin a preview model. A generated clip is not editable 3D geometry.

references.title: Motion · Gesture animation
references.finding: Hover, press, focus and drag APIs support feedback on real controls. Specific timings and visual treatments in this study are WDA proposals.

references.title: Motion · Accessibility
references.finding: Reduced-motion policy can govern transforms and custom media behavior. The app must also stop its own shaders and decorative video.

references.title: MDN · Page Visibility API
references.finding: Document visibility changes let the application suspend decorative media when the page is hidden. Resume from state rather than counting background frames.

references.title: W3C · Pause, Stop, Hide
references.finding: Automatically moving content lasting more than five seconds alongside other content needs a way to pause, stop or hide it. This proposal uses short ambient introductions that settle.

assets: One illustration-only plate per pose: welcome, potting, observing, soil check and writing.
Separate foreground olive leaves and background foliage where a layered implementation is preferable.
A matched still poster for each picture; no baked-in field labels or buttons.
motion.extraction: Use each approved Pocket Garden screen as a composition reference, then isolate ONLY its illustration region. Preserve the same gardener face, dark curls, clothing, Pip olive plant, pot, window and painterly texture. Remove all logos, text, controls and panels from the motion input, reconstructing only the small areas formerly covered by UI. Return the clean illustration plate and optional leaf layers with genuine alpha. Keep the full screenshot separately for compositing comparison.
motion.production: Use a clipped IllustrationMotion region with a still poster and a short muted inline clip. motion.title: A home that feels inhabited
motion.method: Veo house study; precise UI transitions
motion.overview: Bring the soft clay house to life with a little window warmth and foliage movement. Keep the adult avatar consistent and let handover actions, read states and invitations carry the functional feedback.

references.title: Motion · Accessibility
references.finding: Reduced-motion policy can govern transforms and custom media behavior. The app must also stop its own shaders and decorative video.

references.title: MDN · Page Visibility API
references.finding: Document visibility changes let the application suspend decorative media when the page is hidden. Resume from state rather than counting background frames.

references.title: W3C · Pause, Stop, Hide
references.finding: Automatically moving content lasting more than five seconds alongside other content needs a way to pause, stop or hide it. This proposal uses short ambient introductions that settle.

motion.title: Weather with a little dimension
motion.overview: Extract the sun and cloud language from the approved blue scene, then animate reconstructed objects with a fixed camera. The forecast stays data driven; the sculpture gives it character.

references.title: React Three Fiber · Scaling performance
references.finding: On-demand rendering and explicit invalidation support scenes that stop when still. Reuse geometry and materials; measure the actual mobile workload.

references.title: Google · Video generation
references.finding: Image-directed video is a motion-study option. Use a currently supported Veo endpoint at production time; these briefs intentionally do not pin a preview model. A generated clip is not editable 3D geometry.

references.title: Motion · Gesture animation
references.finding: Hover, press, focus and drag APIs support feedback on real controls. Specific timings and visual treatments in this study are WDA proposals.

references.title: Motion · Accessibility
references.finding: Reduced-motion policy can govern transforms and custom media behavior. The app must also stop its own shaders and decorative video.

references.title: MDN · Page Visibility API
references.finding: Document visibility changes let the application suspend decorative media when the page is hidden. Resume from state rather than counting background frames.

references.title: W3C · Pause, Stop, Hide
references.finding: Automatically moving content lasting more than five seconds alongside other content needs a way to pause, stop or hide it. This proposal uses short ambient introductions that settle.

assets: Separate sun sphere, each visible capsule-shaped ray and cream cloud lobe group.
Transparent reference cutouts plus a combined still, with normalized placement and occlusion notes.
Reconstructed GLB with named nodes Sun, Rays and Cloud; fixed-camera lighting reference and still fallback. These are future deliverables.
motion.extraction: Use Soul 03-today as the primary visual reference and 01-place as supporting silhouette reference. Extract ONLY the orange sun sphere, each visible orange capsule ray and cream cloud as separate transparent RGBA cutouts, maintaining visible edges, overlap, clay-like grain, scale and upper-left light. Also export the combined group on transparency, a clean blue background plate, and normalized anchor/bounding-box notes. No title, temperatures, forecast chart, icons or OS chrome. Mark occluded surfaces as unknown; do not claim to recover hidden geometry. Next reconstruct editable 3D meshes to match the cutouts, with named Sun/Rays/Cloud nodes, local pivots, consistent material/light settings and a fixed camera. Deliver a GLB and a matching rendered poster. A cutout is a 2D source reference, not a recovered 3D model.
motion.production: Implement WeatherObjects in React Three Fiber with the reconstructed named meshes. Use a fixed camera; no orbit controls. One 4-second introduction allows the cloud to drift at most 4 logical px and sun rays to turn at most 2 degrees before returning to rest. Keep all meshes outside text-safe bounds; decorative canvas is pointer-events:none. Forecast conditions choose the object group from real state; transitions crossfade 200 ms without inventing measurements. Reuse geometry/materials, render on demand when still, and stop the frame loop when reduced, hidden or offscreen. Settings with Reduce motion ON always shows the still.

alternatives.title: Play before library
alternatives.detail: Try a little arrangement can lead directly to Citrus 01; completing it opens the library with 1/12. Keep tutorial progress separate. Compare first puzzle completion and ability to find another collection.

checks: Play contains five strips; 1, 3 and 5 aligned = 3/5 = 60%.
Completion aligns all five and stores Citrus 01 exactly once.
Collections pictured before play is 0/12; after completion it becomes 1/12.
Profile total counts completed IDs, not visits; replay cannot inflate the count.

auxiliary_routes.account-link: Optional account linking with consent to sync local progress. Success unions puzzle IDs; failure retains all guest data and offers retry. Cancel returns to Profile without a lost-progress warning loop.
auxiliary_routes.pause: Modal with Resume, Restart and Collections. Resume restores offsets, Restart opens its confirmation, Collections saves partial state. Escape/Back resumes; focus returns to the selected strip.
auxiliary_routes.restart-confirm: Keep playing preserves every strip offset. Restart resets only the current puzzle’s in-progress arrangement, never the completed-ID history or other collections.
auxiliary_routes.restore-progress: Offer Continue on this device and optional sign-in restore. Show local and remote counts before an explicit merge; union completed IDs without adding duplicates. Cancel keeps guest progress.

motion.title: Every piece has a gentle place
motion.overview: Animate the actual botanical strips and their alignment. The pleasure comes from a small, precise snap and the whole picture coming together, with the calm illustration carrying the atmosphere.

references.title: Motion · Gesture animation

motion.interaction_prompt:
WDA / Petal — interaction and motion implementation prompt

Read data/flows.json for this app, interaction/petal.md, and interaction/motion/petal.md before implementation. Implement the full documented flow including auxiliary routes and recovery; five images are representative states, not a linear five-step slideshow.

ART DIRECTION
Original Petal art direction: precise painterly lemon, blossom and leaf botanical artwork on creamy paper; expressive refined serif headlines, muted olive utility text, warm coral controls, thin botanical dividers. Preserve the original illustration-based strip puzzle, not abstract colour bars.
Fonts: Cormorant Garamond, DM Sans. Palette: #FFF9EC, #718064, #E8795B, #993D2A. Preserve full-bleed square edges, airy internal spacing, exact UI content and no OS chrome.

APP MOTION
Animate the actual botanical strips and their alignment. The pleasure comes from a small, precise snap and the whole picture coming together, with the calm illustration carrying the atmosphere.
Build BotanicalPuzzle with one source illustration and five clipped horizontal bands. Store normalized x offsets per puzzle ID, selected strip and completed IDs. During horizontal drag use direct pointer movement and capture only after intent; keep vertical scroll available. Snap when within 4% of board width of the valid alignment, using 180 ms ease-out; invalid release returns to its last valid offset in 180 ms. Tap a strip then its alignment target, or keyboard arrows with Enter to place and Escape to cancel, performs the same move. No inertia, confetti, random progress or video-driven game state. Completion checks all five offsets and saves one ID; reduced motion places immediately.

INTERACTION RULES
Touch is primary. Enable rollover only for (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine). Every hover cue has a focus-visible equivalent; no action or information is available only on hover. Pointer exit restores the resting style without changing selection. Use native buttons, links and labeled fields, not clickable artwork.

Proposed tokens: hover 120 ms; press tint 80 ms; focus outline immediate; route crossfade 160 ms; small state changes 180 ms; expanded content 220 ms. Ease with cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), without overshoot. No animation delays navigation, saving or focus.

Play at most one 4-second decorative introduction on first eligible entry per session, then settle to the approved still. Do not replay on field focus, typing, tab return or scroll. This is the default without adding new controls to the approved screens. Continuous motion is a later option only with a visible, keyboard-operable Pause animation control; record that as an additional control before implementation.

effectiveReducedMotion = system preference OR saved app preference. When true, use a static poster, freeze shader time and 3D poses, remove parallax, and apply state changes immediately. Functional pointer-following remains direct, with no inertial or settling animation. Text and status feedback remain complete.

Use normal document scroll; never hijack scrolling or move the foreground type with a background effect. Decorative layers stay inside their illustration region. Suspend them when offscreen, document-hidden, an editor has keyboard focus, or a modal covers the screen. Return to the same phase without catch-up bursts.

Keep text, navigation and forms in the DOM above pointer-events:none, aria-hidden decorative layers. A missing asset, failed video, unavailable WebGL or context loss immediately shows the approved still. Media is muted, plays inline and does not request sound or device-motion permissions. Measure a target of 30 fps for ambient rendering; cap DPR at 1.5 initially and fall back when consistently slow. These are design budgets, not measured results.

DATA
Citrus contains 12 arrangements. The library starts at zero complete; Citrus 01 is shown at 3 of 5 aligned (60%). Completion aligns all five and records one completed arrangement. Profile shows 1 of 12. Pear orchard has 10 arrangements; Wild rose has 8; both remain at zero.

VERIFIED BUILD REFERENCES

  Application: Hover, press, focus and drag APIs support feedback on real controls. Specific timings and visual treatments in this study are WDA proposals.

Approved visual reference: images/mobile/daybook/04-week.png. Full app rules: prompts/interaction/daybook.txt. Product research: interaction/daybook.md. Motion/build references: interaction/motion/daybook.md.

ENTRY: Save changes / Week tab
STATE: DAYBOOK. Heading "A week with breathing room". "15–21 June 2026". Seven day selectors exactly "Mon15 Tue16 Wed17 Thu18 Fri19 Sat20 Sun21" with ONLY Thu 18 selected. "Thursday, 18 June". Agenda "18:30–19:10 Walk by the water" / "40 min · Riverside path"; "19:15–20:15 Dinner on the terrace" / "60 min". Small success message "Plan updated". Quiet previous/next week arrows. Bottom Today / Week / Places; ONLY Week active.
DISPLAY: Brand, headings, body copy, background texture, decorative vignettes and dividers are noninteractive. Read meaningful copy in document order; decorative artwork uses empty alt. OS chrome is intentionally omitted from exports; production safe-area insets belong to the app shell. Step markers communicate progress and are not buttons. Numeric totals derive from saved data or the explicitly described draft. Any exceptions appear in the control ledger.
AMBIENT: The selected Thursday arc uses the same date and weather data as Today.
ACTIONS: Day hover gives a thin outline; only activation changes selection. A successful saved edit moves the plan endpoint over180ms and shows Plan updated. Week arrows never alter the selected plan contents.
SCROLL/RETURN: One vertical scroll region. Preserve the airy spacing; at small heights or large text allow scrolling instead of scaling text down. Keep the bottom destination navigation above the safe area when present, and add content inset so it covers nothing. Keyboard opening scrolls the focused field into view; closing it restores the prior position. No horizontal paging gesture changes destination. Motion layer: Return from another tab preserves selected day and week. Missing date data shows a readable empty state, not invented daylight. Use normal document scroll; never hijack scrolling or move the foreground type with a background effect. Decorative layers stay inside their illustration region. Suspend them when offscreen, document-hidden, an editor has keyboard focus, or a modal covers the screen. Return to the same phase without catch-up bursts.

effectiveReducedMotion = system preference OR saved app preference. When true, use a static poster, freeze shader time and 3D poses, remove parallax, and apply state changes immediately. Functional pointer-following remains direct, with no inertial or settling animation. Text and status feedback remain complete.

EVERY CONTROL


Implement daybook.04.01 (Day selectors) as date. Input: Tap picker or type. Result: Update selected day and list; selected day has an explicit selected state distinct from focus. Target: self. Calendar with keyboard support and typed alternative; keep timezone explicit. Selected date is not keyboard focus. Hover: 120 ms border tint. Focus: immediate visible outline with stable label; no scale or placeholder movement. Touch opens the native editing affordance. Freeze decoration during editing. Preserve draft, selection and keyboard position; validate without shaking the field.

Implement daybook.04.02 (Previous / next week) as button. Input: Tap/click; Enter or Space. Result: Move seven days, keep weekday selection; month/year labels recalculated. Target: self. Button with visible focus; pending state only for asynchronous work. Return focus after a sheet closes. Hover: 120 ms contextual fill/border tint. Focus: immediate visible outline. Press: 80 ms darker tint without layout shift. Exit/canceled press restores rest. Activate on release/keyboard once; preserve labels while pending, suppress duplicate submits, and show explicit success/error. No decorative animation gates the action.

Implement daybook.04.03 (Walk / Dinner rows) as button. Input: Tap/click; Enter or Space. Result: Open selected record by ID; keep return Week and scroll position. Target: 03-editor. Press: 80 ms darker tint without layout shift. Exit/canceled press restores rest. Activate on release/keyboard once; preserve labels while pending, suppress duplicate submits, and show explicit success/error. No decorative animation gates the action.

Implement daybook.04.04 (Plan updated message) as status. Input: No input. Result: Live announcement after save; not a button; dismiss visually after 4 seconds without moving focus. Target: none. Update text from real state; announce meaningful changes politely once.

Implement daybook.04.05 (Date header) as button. Input: Tap/click; Enter or Space. Result: Open date picker; preserve the current destination and its return route. Target: aux:date-picker. Button with visible focus; pending state only for asynchronous work. Return focus after a sheet closes. Hover: 120 ms contextual fill/border tint. Focus: immediate visible outline. Press: 80 ms darker tint without layout shift. Exit/canceled press restores rest. Activate on release/keyboard once; preserve labels while pending, suppress duplicate submits, and show explicit success/error. No decorative animation gates the action.

Implement daybook.04.06 (Daylight arc) as link. Input: Tap/click; Enter. Result: Open daylight details for the selected day; Back returns to Week. Target: aux:daylight-detail. Preserve independent tab scroll and draft state; selecting the active destination is a no-op. Target: 02-today. Route link inside nav; aria-current=page on the active destination. No automatic save, sound or permission request on navigation. Hover: 120 ms underline/tint. Focus: immediate outline. Press: 80 ms tint; no image/card movement. Exit restores rest without changing active destination. Route crossfade 160 ms after activation; reduced motion immediate. Active route selection is a no-op; preserve route scroll/drafts.

Implement daybook.04.nav.2 (Week) as navigation. Input: Tap/click or Enter. Result: Open Week; show only its selected state. Never rasterize UI text or controls into a background video. No OS status bar or home indicator. Preserve native aspect ratio. Auxiliary destinations follow the app ledger, not another unrelated app screen.

alternatives.title: Plan before calendar
alternatives.detail: Start with one local evening plan, then offer read-only calendar import after saving. Manual planning remains complete on its own. Compare first-plan save and duplicate imported events.

checks: At 18:00, sunset 20:58 leaves 2h 58m.
Before edit, walk 18:30–19:05 = 35 minutes; draft end 19:10 = 40.
Save commits 40 minutes; Cancel keeps 35. Reminder 10 minutes before 18:30 is 18:20.
Week is 15–21 June 2026; Thursday is 18 June. Preserve Europe/Lisbon.

auxiliary_routes.calendar-permission: Explain read-only calendar import → select provider/calendar → explicit Connect. Show loading and connected status only after success. Denied, cancelled or unavailable returns to manual planning. Imported items keep source IDs; editing read-only events opens the source or creates an explicitly separate local copy.
auxiliary_routes.city-search: Labeled city search, clear-query button, result list with country and timezone, loading/no-results/error states. Selection uses a stable city ID. Add/Use is explicit; duplicate saved city selects the existing record. Cancel restores the invoking route and draft.
auxiliary_routes.date-picker: Labeled month/year and date grid, previous/next month and Today. Keyboard date navigation and typed-date alternative. Apply selects day in Europe/Lisbon; Cancel preserves date and scroll.
auxiliary_routes.daylight-detail: Show sunrise, sunset and daylight window as readable times with timezone/source. Optional reminder requires its own explicit action. Close returns to the initiating row/arc; polar-day/no-data states need explanatory text.
auxiliary_routes.delete-plan: Confirm Delete / Keep plan. Success removes the selected record and returns to Today with Undo; failure keeps the form and record. Undo restores the original ID and times.
auxiliary_routes.discard-plan: Keep editing returns to the dirty form. Discard restores the saved 18:30–19:05 / 35-minute walk and returns to the caller. Never commit the displayed 40-minute draft implicitly.
auxiliary_routes.place-detail: Show saved name, description and location with Edit and Use in a plan. In editor-picker mode, Select this place returns its ID to the existing draft. Back never discards that draft.
auxiliary_routes.place-editor: Labeled name (1–80), note (0–500), city/location, Save and Cancel. Create increments saved count once; edit updates the same ID. Duplicate candidates offer Use existing / Keep separate. Dirty Cancel confirms discard.
auxiliary_routes.plan-editor: Use the plan editor for the selected record, including dinner; it carries recordId and returnTo. Save updates that record only. Cancel preserves saved values; errors keep the draft.

motion.title: Time moves; the page stays calm
